root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `cellToVertex()` can evaluate `if (leftNeighbor < owner)`, the left-neighbor lookup call must have returned `E_SUCCESS`; otherwise the helper may have returned before writing the out-parameter slot for `leftNeighbor`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable call site discards the `H3Error` from `h3NeighborRotations(cell, left, &lRotations, &leftNeighbor)`. On the crashing witness that expression returns `E_CELL_INVALID`, yet the compare on `leftNeighbor` still executes. The fixed code adds the missing check and returns early on the same nonzero result; the nearby valid-cell perturbation makes the same call return `E_SUCCESS` and then execute the protected compare as a genuine witness.

nodes.state: At the selected sink compare, `cellToVertex()` still reaches `if (leftNeighbor < owner)` even though the selected left-neighbor lookup returned a nonzero `H3Error`.

edges.relation: The exact stack slot passed as `&leftNeighbor` to the selected lookup call is the same `leftNeighbor` lvalue later read at the sink compare, so the stale out-parameter state reaches the sanitizer sink unchanged.
